user.title: Connect controller
user.description: Sign in with your controller account, then select a project and site. An empty password is allowed for accounts configured without one. Disabling certificate verification leaves server identity unchecked.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew session
reauth_confirm.description: Enter account credentials again. The project and site remain unchanged.

project.title: Select project
project.description: Each project is configured as a separate integration entry.

reconfigure.title: Change sign-in
reconfigure.description: Switch to username/password sign-in. The project, site and entity IDs are retained.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach controller or decode its FIN response.

init.title: Polling and controls
init.description: Controls change FIN default values. Schedules and manual overrides may take precedence. Writes have not been verified against real hardware. Disable domestic hot water to hide its sensors and controls. This does not change controller operation. Alarm push checks active alarms about every 5 seconds. On iPhone, delivery uses the Companion App and Apple push. Then press the device button "Alarm-Push testen". If no phone appears, first connect the Companion App and allow notifications. Cycling is estimated from electrical power (at/above threshold on, below off). Short phases between polls are not captured.

data.alarm_notify_service: Alarm push destination (iPhone: Apple Push / Companion App)
data.power_threshold_w: Cycling: electrical power threshold per heat pump (W)

pv_charge.title: Temporary PV buffer charging
pv_charge.description: Disabled until explicitly enabled. The supported offset is 0–10 °C; a stop limit up to 75 °C does not command that absolute target. Power sources require W/kW and regular fresh updates; temperature requires °C. Normal charging requires valid actual buffer feedback; only the explicitly selected hardware test omits it. Sensorless test: real heat-pump write without temperature cutoff. Start manually under supervision, never for unattended operation. Maximum 5 minutes and 2 °C additional offset. Automatic start must be off. The previous offset is restored afterwards when the controller is reachable.

data.pv_charge_auto: Start automatically when PV export is stable
data.pv_charge_confirmed: Power readings, signs and mixing circuit checked; temperature protection verified OR explicitly selected the sensorless test above
data.pv_charge_export_positive: Positive grid sensor values mean export
data.pv_charge_discharge_positive: Positive battery sensor values mean discharge
data.pv_charge_temperature_sensor: Actual buffer temperature at the hottest monitored point
data.pv_charge_offset: Temporary offset relative to zones (not an absolute target)
data.pv_charge_max_c: Buffer temperature stop limit (not a 75 °C target)
data.pv_charge_test_without_temperature: Explicit charge test WITHOUT buffer sensor (manual, max. 5 min, up to 2 °C additional offset)

error.notification_target_unavailable: The selected phone is not available as a notification target. Connect the Companion App or disable alarm push.
error.pv_charge_not_confirmed: Enable experimental controls and confirm the verified prerequisites.
error.pv_charge_missing_sources: Select all three power sources and, for normal charging, the actual buffer temperature.
error.pv_charge_thresholds: The start threshold must exceed the stop threshold.
error.pv_charge_test_manual_only: Sensorless charge tests do not allow automatic start.
